verses.original: Τὸ λοιπὸν ἀδελφοί προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ Κυρίου τρέχῃ καὶ δοξάζηται καθὼς καὶ πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: To loipon adelphoi proseuchesthe peri hēmōn hina ho logos tou Kyriou trechē kai doxazētai kathōs kai pros hymas
verses.literal: - Finally brothers pray for us that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor just as [it was] with you

verses.original: καὶ ἵνα ῥυσθῶμεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀτόπων καὶ πονηρῶν ἀνθρώπων γὰρ οὐ πάντων ἡ πίστις
verses.transliteration: kai hina rhysthōmen apo tōn atopōn kai ponērōn anthrōpōn gar ou pantōn hē pistis
verses.literal: And [pray] that we may be delivered from - wicked and evil men for not everyone [ holds to ] the faith

verses.original: δέ ὁ Κύριος ἐστιν Πιστὸς ὃς στηρίξει καὶ φυλάξει ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ
verses.transliteration: de ho Kyrios estin Pistos hos stērixei kai phylaxei hymas apo tou ponērou
verses.literal: But the Lord is faithful [and He] will strengthen [you] and guard you from the evil [one]

verses.original: δὲ πεποίθαμεν ἐν Κυρίῳ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ὅτι καὶ ποιεῖτε καὶ ποιήσετε ἃ παραγγέλλομεν
verses.transliteration: de pepoithamen en Kyriō eph’ hymas hoti kai poieite kai poiēsete ha parangellomen
verses.literal: And we have confidence in [the] Lord - - that - you are doing and will continue to do what we command

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Κύριος κατευθύναι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας εἰς τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ εἰς τοῦ Χριστοῦ τὴν ὑπομονὴν
verses.transliteration: de HO Kyrios kateuthynai hymōn tas kardias eis tou Theou tēn agapēn kai eis tou Christou tēn hypomonēn
verses.literal: - {May} the Lord direct your - hearts into - God’s - love and - - Christ’s - perseverance

verses.original: δὲ Παραγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν ἀδελφοί ἐν ὀνόματι ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὑμᾶς στέλλεσθαι ἀπὸ παντὸς ἀδελφοῦ περιπατοῦντος ἀτάκτως καὶ μὴ κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ἣν παρελάβοσαν παρ’ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: de Parangellomen hymin adelphoi en onomati hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou hymas stellesthai apo pantos adelphou peripatountos ataktōs kai mē kata tēn paradosin hēn parelabosan par’ hēmōn
verses.literal: Now we command you brothers in [the] name of our - Lord Jesus Christ - to keep away from any brother [who] leads an undisciplined life [that is] not in keeping with the tradition - you received from us

verses.original: γὰρ αὐτοὶ οἴδατε πῶς δεῖ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς ὅτι οὐκ ἠτακτήσαμεν ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: gar autoi oidate pōs dei mimeisthai hēmas hoti ouk ētaktēsamen en hymin
verses.literal: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us because vvv we were not undisciplined among you

verses.original: οὐδὲ ἐφάγομεν παρά τινος ἄρτον δωρεὰν ἀλλ’ ἐν κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ ἐργαζόμενοι νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας πρὸς μὴ τὸ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: oude ephagomen para tinos arton dōrean all’ en kopō kai mochthō ergazomenoi nyktos kai hēmeras pros mē to epibarēsai tina hymōn
verses.literal: nor did we eat vvv anyone’s food without paying for it Instead in labor and toil we worked night and day so that vvv vvv we would not be a burden to any of you

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν ἀλλ’ ἵνα δῶμεν ἑαυτοὺς τύπον ὑμῖν εἰς τὸ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: ouch hoti ouk echomen exousian all’ hina dōmen heautous typon hymin eis to mimeisthai hēmas
verses.literal: Not that vvv we lack [this] right but we wanted to offer ourselves [as] an example for you to - imitate -

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ ὅτε ἦμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς παρηγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν τοῦτο ὅτι Εἴ τις οὐ θέλει ἐργάζεσθαι μηδὲ ἐσθιέτω
verses.transliteration: gar kai hote ēmen pros hymas parēngellomen hymin touto hoti Ei tis ou thelei ergazesthai mēde esthietō
verses.literal: For even while we were with you we gave you this command . . . . . . - If anyone vvv is unwilling to work vvv he shall not eat

verses.original: γάρ Ἀκούομεν τινας ἐν ὑμῖν περιπατοῦντας ἀτάκτως ἐργαζομένους μηδὲν ἀλλὰ περιεργαζομένους
verses.transliteration: gar Akouomen tinas en hymin peripatountas ataktōs ergazomenous mēden alla periergazomenous
verses.literal: For we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives accomplishing nothing but being busybodies

verses.original: δὲ παραγγέλλομεν καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν τοῖς τοιούτοις ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ ἵνα ἐργαζόμενοι μετὰ ἡσυχίας ἐσθίωσιν ἑαυτῶν τὸν ἄρτον
verses.transliteration: de parangellomen kai parakaloumen tois toioutois en Kyriō Iēsou Christō hina ergazomenoi meta hēsychias esthiōsin heautōn ton arton
verses.literal: - We command and urge - such [people] by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working vvv quietly to earn their own living . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: δέ Ὑμεῖς ἀδελφοί μὴ ἐγκακήσητε καλοποιοῦντες
verses.transliteration: de Hymeis adelphoi mē enkakēsēte kalopoiountes
verses.literal: But [as for] you brothers {do} not grow weary [in] well-doing

verses.original: δέ σημειοῦσθε τοῦτον Εἰ τις οὐχ ὑπακούει τῷ λόγῳ ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ἐπιστολῆς μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι αὐτῷ ἵνα ἐντραπῇ
verses.transliteration: de sēmeiousthe touton Ei tis ouch hypakouei tō logō hēmōn dia tēs epistolēs mē synanamignysthai autō hina entrapē
verses.literal: - Take note of - anyone who {does} not obey the instructions we have given . . . in [this] letter {Do} not associate with him so that he may be ashamed

verses.original: καὶ μὴ ἡγεῖσθε ὡς ἐχθρὸν ἀλλὰ νουθετεῖτε ὡς ἀδελφόν
verses.transliteration: kai mē hēgeisthe hōs echthron alla noutheteite hōs adelphon
verses.literal: Yet {do} not regard [him] as an enemy but admonish [him] as a brother

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Κύριος τῆς εἰρήνης Αὐτὸς δῴη ὑμῖν τὴν εἰρήνην διὰ παντὸς ἐν παντὶ τρόπῳ ὁ Κύριος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: de ho Kyrios tēs eirēnēs Autos dōē hymin tēn eirēnēn dia pantos en panti tropō ho Kyrios meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: Now {may} the Lord - of peace Himself give you - peace at all [times] [and] in every way The Lord [be] with all of you

verses.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς ἐμῇ τῇ χειρὶ Παύλου ὅ ἐστιν σημεῖον ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιστολῇ οὕτως γράφω
verses.transliteration: Ho aspasmos emē tē cheiri Paulou ho estin sēmeion en pasē epistolē houtōs graphō
verses.literal: [This] greeting [is] in my own - hand Paul This is [my] mark in every letter it is the way I write

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of our - Lord Jesus Christ [be] with all of you
